info.title: PlaybookIQ API
info.description: Team, situational, and player analytics on nflverse play-by-play data, plus private CSV uploads and saved scouting reports. Unsafe requests require the `X-PlaybookIQ-CSRF: 1` header; private endpoints require a session cookie from /api/v1/auth/login.

get.description: Ready when the database answers. Redis is reported but optional (cache degrades).

post.description: Revoke every session for this user (all devices), including the current one.
